query: BEGIN;SET LOCAL statement_timeout='5s';SET LOCAL lock_timeout='1s';WITH recent AS MATERIALIZED(SELECT runid,jobid,status,start_time,end_time,return_message FROM cron.job_run_details ORDER BY runid DESC LIMIT 100)SELECT jsonb_build_object('at',clock_timestamp(),'jobs',(SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',jobid,'name',jobname,'active',active,'schedule',schedule,'command_md5',md5(command)))FROM cron.job WHERE jobid IN(30,31)),'recent_maintenance',(SELECT jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(r))FROM(SELECT*FROM recent WHERE jobid=31 ORDER BY runid DESC LIMIT 3)r),'admission',(SELECT value FROM zoi.delivery_state WHERE key='enrichment_admission_v1'));COMMIT;
